Graphics – 6/10
Sound – 5/10
Gameplay – 6/10
Story – 2/10

Overall – Zcrew is a cheap, bad, game that you can play on steam during a lan party or something. You’ll have much more fun picking apart the things within the game than actually playing it. This can definitely bring hours of “enjoyment.” Recommended.
